question: Who won the 2025 Booker Prize, and for which book?
text: David Szalay won the 2025 Booker Prize for his novel *Flesh*. ([thebookerprizes.com](https://thebookerprizes.com/media-centre/press-releases/flesh-by-david-szalay-wins-the-booker-prize-2025?utm_source=openai))
